answer: Gate each identity with a hardware-bound uniqueness kernel: every epoch the agent must countersign a random peer batch using a key that never leaves a measured device, then park the merklized receipt in a public haven for two epochs before rewards vest. If two keys share device fingerprints or timing twins, both bonds burn. A farm therefore needs a distinct machine and idle stake per name, so minting a crowd is no longer a cheap fable told in swapped adjectives.
